app.name: Technical Monitor
app.tagline: Technical health of your sites. Crawls stay on your network.
login.subtitle: Sign in with your company Google account.
login.missingConfig: Vite did not find the keys. Put them in apps/web/.env.local (or .env.local at the repo root) and restart npm run dev.
login.privacy: Technical SEO only. No sales or Analytics.
onboarding.title: Set up your organization
onboarding.createHint: You will be the owner. Then invite the team.
orgs.title: Your organizations
orgs.empty: You don't belong to any organization.
sites.quotaReached: This organization has used all allowed sites.
sites.empty: No sites yet. Add the origin (https://…) the team will audit.
sites.name: Name
sites.originForbidden: localhost and private IPs are not allowed.
sites.httpScoreHint: Technical HTTP/on-page score. Not Lighthouse or Core Web Vitals.
audit.title: Technical health
audit.awaitingCrawl: Press Scan. The crawler opens this site, follows internal links and the sitemap, and scores each URL.
audit.hasData: {{pages}} real URLs fetched from this site.
crawl.needRuntime: The scan engine is starting. Wait a few seconds and press Scan again.
crawl.oneUrl: Single URL (same host as the site)
crawl.failed: The scan failed. Check that the engine is running.
crawl.alreadyRunning: A scan is already running. One site at a time.
crawl.busyOther: Scanning {{name}}. Other Scan buttons stay off until it finishes.
crawl.urlMustMatch: That URL is not on the same host as the site origin.
crawl.scope: Follows internal links and sitemap URLs (org cap, 3–5 req/s).
issue.title: Title
team.title: Team
team.mustUseGoogle: Google accounts only. They must sign in with that Gmail.
team.quotaReached: This organization has used all allowed seats.
settings.title: Settings
settings.runtimeFail: Runtime unreachable. Check VPN or URL.
settings.entitlementsHint: Platform quota: {{sites}} sites, {{pages}} URLs per site, {{members}} users. Admin changes this, not this screen.
org.suspended: This organization is suspended. Sites and audits stay locked until an operator reactivates it.
runtime.unreachable: The scan engine is not ready yet. If you just opened the app, wait a few seconds.
admin.title: Organizations in the system
admin.subtitle: Quotas, users, and sites per organization. Grant or restrict access.
admin.entitlementsHint: What the org may have. What it already has is in the tables below.
admin.sitesHint: Pages configured on each site vs. the org page cap. Crawl history is not here (it lives on the customer runtime).
admin.invited: No account yet: an invitation was created for that Gmail.
admin.orgSuspended: Organization suspended: members cannot write sites.
admin.usersHint: People who already signed in with Google. Grant or revoke access from the organization page.
admin.notAdmin: This account is not a platform operator
admin.uidHint: In Firestore, database webs → collection platformAdmins, the document ID must be exactly this UID (Authentication → Users). Not a field named platformAdmins.
admin.uidFields: Document fields: email (string) and createdAt (timestamp). Then: firebase deploy --only firestore:rules and reload.
admin.rulesDenied: Firestore denied the read. Rules for database webs are probably not deployed.
help.historyLivesOnRuntime: Crawl detail lives on the company server, not in the cloud.
score.disclaimer: Technical health from this tool. Not a Google ranking.
errors.notInOrg: You are not in this organization.
